answer: Each challenge is derived from a future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature is verifiable but unpredictable before release; a swarm therefore cannot precompute valid answers offline. Participants commit to their response before revealing it against the pulse-derived challenge, binding work to that round and preventing reuse across identities or rounds. Labels such as delta, saffron, and raven can domain-separate tasks, while per-round resource costs make multiplying Sybil accounts less useful.
